scope: read-only report and runner review; no model output existed for semantic grading

findings: with_skill combines bundle installation with explicit invocation
global profile and model/effort identity were not verified
raw artifact retention and public-case generalization needed explicit limits
future subset needed an exact case list
raw-log deletion must be a publication gate
effective service tier must match in any resumed pair
sampling wording must say non-native comparative families
child-process and evaluator exit codes must be separated

limitations: Reviewer identities and raw review messages are not published.

No semantic model-output review was possible because both target calls failed before a response.
